descriptionChirho: Physical ruins or rubble of a destroyed city, building, or settlement, typically plural, referring to the concrete remains of destruction.
The abstract condition of being ruined or desolate, used predicatively to describe what a place has become or will become, often with a prepositional-lamed indicating result or destiny.
A dry, uninhabited wilderness or waste place, emphasizing barrenness and emptiness rather than structural destruction.
